items.stem:
(a) Why is the voters' list updated regularly? What would happen if it were not? (3 marks)
(b) Why does a candidate pay a security deposit when filing a nomination? (2 marks)
items.answer: (a) (1) New voters turning 18 must be added. (2) Names of dead persons and those who have moved must be removed. (3) Without updating, eligible people could be left out and fake voting could occur. (b) (1) To discourage people who are not serious from contesting. (2) The deposit is forfeited if the candidate gets less than one-sixth of the votes.

items.stem:

(b) Why does a candidate pay a security deposit when filing a nomination? (2 marks)
items.answer: (a) (1) India follows the first-past-the-post system. (2) The candidate with the most votes wins even without a majority. (3) Criticism: a majority of voters may have voted against the winner. (b) (1) To discourage people who are not serious from contesting. (2) The deposit is forfeited if the candidate gets less than one-sixth of the votes.
